changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Ciclo de vida de la incidencia (ARC-113): asignacion, liberacion, marcas de estado, cierre y autoria del cambio de estado

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Columnas virtuales de solo lectura del ciclo de vida: closed_by_user_id (nombre T.5) y retention_expires_at (REQ-148 / AC-RET-01)
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE incidencia ADD ( closed_by_user_id GENERATED ALWAYS AS (closed_by) VIRTUAL, retention_expires_at DATE GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CAST(created_at + INTERVAL '24' MONTH AS DATE)) VIRTUAL )

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Claves ajenas de los cuatro actores del ciclo de vida (tecnico asignado, liberador, cerrador y autor del cambio de estado) contra usuario
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE incidencia ADD CONSTRAINT fk_incidencia_assigned_technician FOREIGN KEY (assigned_technician_id) REFERENCES usuario (user_id)
ALTER TABLE incidencia ADD CONSTRAINT fk_incidencia_released_by FOREIGN KEY (released_by) REFERENCES usuario (user_id)
ALTER TABLE incidencia ADD CONSTRAINT fk_incidencia_closed_by FOREIGN KEY (closed_by) REFERENCES usuario (user_id)
ALTER TABLE incidencia ADD CONSTRAINT fk_incidencia_status_changed_by FOREIGN KEY (status_changed_by) REFERENCES usuario (user_id)

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE incidencia DROP CONSTRAINT fk_incidencia_status_changed_by
ALTER TABLE incidencia DROP CONSTRAINT fk_incidencia_closed_by
ALTER TABLE incidencia DROP CONSTRAINT fk_incidencia_released_by
ALTER TABLE incidencia DROP CONSTRAINT fk_incidencia_assigned_technician

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Reglas declarativas del ciclo de vida: coexistencia del cierre, orden cronologico, coherencia de la liberacion y asignacion con instante
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE incidencia ADD CONSTRAINT ck_incidencia_cierre_coexiste CHECK ( (status = 'CERRADA' AND closed_at IS NOT NULL AND closed_by IS NOT NULL) OR (status <> 'CERRADA' AND closed_at IS NULL AND closed_by IS NULL) )

ALTER TABLE incidencia ADD CONSTRAINT ck_incidencia_cronologia CHECK ( (in_progress_at IS NULL OR in_progress_at >= created_at) AND (resolved_at IS NULL OR resolved_at >= created_at) AND (closed_at IS NULL OR closed_at >= created_at) AND (resolved_at IS NULL OR in_progress_at IS NULL OR resolved_at >= in_progress_at) AND (closed_at IS NULL OR in_progress_at IS NULL OR closed_at >= in_progress_at) AND (closed_at IS NULL OR resolved_at IS NULL OR closed_at >= resolved_at) )

ALTER TABLE incidencia ADD CONSTRAINT ck_incidencia_liberacion CHECK ( (released_at IS NULL AND released_by IS NULL AND release_reason IS NULL) OR (released_at IS NOT NULL AND released_by IS NOT NULL AND release_reason IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(release_reason)) BETWEEN 10 AND 500) )
ALTER TABLE incidencia ADD CONSTRAINT ck_incidencia_asignacion CHECK (assigned_technician_id IS NULL OR assigned_at IS NOT NULL)

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE incidencia DROP CONSTRAINT ck_incidencia_asignacion
ALTER TABLE incidencia DROP CONSTRAINT ck_incidencia_liberacion
ALTER TABLE incidencia DROP CONSTRAINT ck_incidencia_cronologia
ALTER TABLE incidencia DROP CONSTRAINT ck_incidencia_cierre_coexiste

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Indices del historial de cierres por sala y categoria (REQ-113 / AC-CIE-08) y de los filtros de asignacion de la bandeja (REQ-107 / AC-BAN-04)
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX ix_incidencia_cierres_sala_categoria ON incidencia (room_id, category_id, closed_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX ix_incidencia_asignacion ON incidencia (assigned_technician_id, status)
